reviews.t: Best purchase at a small risk
reviews.x: I’ve always use this product and the thought of buying it and it coming to my door step was going to be super easy  instead of a run to the nearest salon store which is about an hour away  but unfortunately it came in a flimsy bag and some of the product has leaked out of one bottle. Luckily it was only a small leakage and nothing to drastic, but some unlucky people may lose their whole product.

I used Ion heat protecting spray for years. When my regular store stopped selling it, I went on a search for something new that worked the same and bought 2 other brands before finally finding BTZ. I use this stuff every single day! It seems oily at first, but when you curl your hair, it magically becomes sleek and soft and looks so healthy! I’m able to go a lot longer between hair trims too because it protects my hair so well from split ends. Oh and it smells great too! I was not paid for this

My friend paid $40 at a hair show for one bottle. Keeps a shine on dull processed or frizzy hair. Suggest spraying it on your hands to apply. As well as keep it away from the skalp or it can leave it looking greasey.

I’ve been using this product for about 13 years and will never use anything else! I have very frizzy curly hair so it makes it feel soft and doesn’t make my hair look/feel crunchy after I straighten it! If you have thin hair or hair that doesn’t have a lot of volume I wouldn’t recommend it since it would probably weigh it down. So if you have super curly frizzy hair get this!!

Just started using this about 5 months ago and love it! My stylist asked if I had been using something different because my color lasted so much better and my hair seemed so much healthier between appointments.
It is light and doesn't wear my lightweight, thin gray/white hair down.  Easy to apply and lasts a good while (the container).  I was glad to find it on Amazon!
I personally love this stuff. I spray it in my hair when it’s wet. Then blow dry. And I see a huge difference in the softness and texture too my hair.

reviews.t: This works great for people with curly and thick frizzy hair
reviews.x: So I have used this product for many years and it the only thing that works to help straighten and protect hair from high heat.

reviews.t: This makes my hair look great!!
reviews.x: I love this product I put it on after my hair is done it gives a great shine & healthy look to my hair.

reviews.t: It really helped my hair not to get burn with the flat iron.
reviews.x: My hair feels really light weight . I safe money by purchasing this 2 items.
Wow, this really works on dry frizzy hair! Love it and it smells so nice!
only heat protection I'll use. leaves hair soft and silky, not oily.

I have been using this for almost 20 years.  I spray a couple of sprays on my palm and rub my hands together and apply it to my almost dry ends to give them texture.  I makes my hair soft shiny and frizz free.  Do NOT apply anywhere near scalp and apply lightly.  Also, if you wait for it to go on sale at Sally's Beauty you can get the bottles for $6 each.  Why would you pay these ridiculous prices?  It is a MUST have for me so I grab 4 or 5 bottles when it goes on sale.  I use it every day and s

This is hands down the best heat protectant spray I’ve ever used, and I’ve been blow drying my hair for 17 years. I’ve used other ones with natural oils and ingredients and they tend to weigh my hair down. I have curly hair and I blow dry it straight weekly, so it can dry and break easily. This spray has kept my hair healthy for many years and it doesn’t look like it has some bulky product on it. It flows freely. It’s a dry oil so it doesn’t leave my hair oily either. Over all, a great product,

This stuff is the best! I curl my hair almost everyday, and this has saves my hair.  I am so happy  the lady at Sally’s told me to get this haha.  This DOES NOT weigh down fine, thin hair. A little goes a long way, though. The spray comes out like a mist so it gives even coverage.

reviews.t: Don’t think twice and stop searching
reviews.x: If you are looking for a very light product for frizzy hair this is the one. Also it’s an OUTSTANDING spray for protecting your hair from heat like blow-dry or hair straightening, it got a beautiful light scent that keep your hair smelling so nice. Love it

This product is all I use on my hair now.  It is light and protects my hair from the flat iron.  I even use it in between flat ironing to give it a smooth look without it being greasy.  Even my stylist now uses it she liked it so much!

Este producto me gusta mucho,  solo pongo un poco en el cabello mojado, lo seco con secadora y al final divido mi cabello en dos y pongo una vez más en cada lado eso quita la estática y me lo deja casi como planchado

Love the product, I have been using it for a wile because I blow dry and straighten my hair a lot. Only issue was the shipping. One came slightly opened and spilled a little inside the bag it came in.
I have thick coarse hair.  Which I color regularly.  U can imagine my texture is off bc of the chemicals..  yet the turn up the heat restores the shine and protects my hair from heat and styling
Eh usado este producto por más de 15 años y es exelente es la primera vez que lo compro aquí pero el precio está muy bien casi el mismo que en Sally que es el lugar donde único lo conseguía
This is by far my favorite heat protector for my hair. It's light weight, doesn't make you hair greasy and it helps my natural hair to stay straighter long when I do put heat in it.
Was more expensive than I have ever purchased it for. Online shopping, while essential at times, is anything but a bargain now. Will be returning to the brick and mortar.
I live by this product. My local Sally’s has been sold out lately so I’m happy I was able to find this product on Amazon. It’s the only thing I use for my hair.

claims.text: Most reviewers love this heat protectant, saying it leaves hair soft, silky, and shiny without feeling oily or crunchy.
Many reviewers are long-time repeat users, some for 13-20 years, and consider it the only heat protectant they'll use.
Several reviewers say it works especially well on curly, thick, or frizzy hair, making it soft and easier to straighten.
Some reviewers warn to apply lightly and keep it away from the scalp, as it can look greasy or weigh down thin hair.
A few reviewers had packaging problems, with product leaking or spilling in transit, and one questioned authenticity due to a different smell.
